headline: Ramayana Day 21: ₹9.50 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana's Day 21 collection so far, on Thursday, 26 November 2026, is ₹9.50 Cr India nett and ₹11.35 Cr India gross, -45.7% from Day 20's ₹17.50 Cr. That is across 15,700 shows at 12.7% occupancy. Updated 04:44 am IST, and still a live estimate rather than the final drop.
body:
Through Day 22 the desk has Ramayana at ₹1,001.8 Cr India nett, ₹1,185.0 Cr India gross, ₹592.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,777.0 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹992.10 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹3.75 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹2.70 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The desk figure remains ₹1,001.8 Cr India nett and ₹1,777.0 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
